name: Advanced Manufacturing
summary: The current shelf now reaches operating training and research facilities, delivered graduate counts, and named industrial receiving systems while keeping projected throughput, aggregate outcomes, qualified production, and regional workforce sufficiency separate.
watch_questions: Which national manufacturing trends can be connected to named establishments, facilities, equipment, output, investment, trade, and customers?
Which institute, roadmap, metrology, and award records progress into qualified processes, repeatable yield, throughput, cost, reliability, and production?
Where do materials, tooling, standards, utilities, labor, and supplier networks limit conversion of designs into deployable systems?
Which operating academies and accelerators disclose enrollment, completion, credential, placement, retention, vacancy, and productivity outcomes?
Which programs connect engagement to completion, credential, placement, retention, quality, throughput, productivity, and customer delivery?
Which recurring measures retain a compatible unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and revision history?
Where does a method change or series break require the longitudinal claim to stop?
Which named entities now have a stable identifier and at least two compatible observations?
Which reporting break, identity change, revision, missing denominator, or attribution limit stops the entity-level line?
Which later records can validate performance without creating a ranking or composite score?
